home.headline: I help Belgian SMEs build credibility and turn traffic into qualified conversations.
home.subheadline: High-performance websites, technical SEO and real-time 3D/VR work, with one senior technical partner from scoping to launch.

trust.title: A clear working model that keeps delivery fast and communication direct
trust.intro: You know what is being built, in what order, and why. The work stays readable from the first conversation to launch.

direct.label: Faster decisions, direct exchanges, and less loss between the brief and execution

delivery.label: Visible validation at each step instead of one large final handoff

quality.label: Performance, SEO and clarity designed to support conversion

process.title: A simple process to scope, build and publish without guesswork
process.intro: The goal is straightforward: understand what needs to be sold, build a credible page or prototype, then verify that the launch supports the original business need.

discovery.title: Clarify the goal before talking about design or technology
discovery.body: We first identify what you sell, who it is for, and what the page or experience needs to make clearer in order to trigger interest.

points.goals: Define the conversion goal and the questions the page needs to answer.
points.queries: Identify the topics and searches that actually matter to your prospects.
points.plan: Shape that into a clear page or prototype with the right proof and calls to action.

build.title: Design and ship something clear, fast and credible
build.body: The work stays pragmatic: clear messaging, easy-to-scan structure, a stack that fits the need, and visible delivery steps.

stackItems.delivery: GitHub · short PRs · visible review checkpoints

launch.title: Publish cleanly and check that the result holds up
launch.body: A launch is not just a finishing step. We verify the quality of what goes live and check whether the page actually helps generate more relevant interest.

verify.body: Review content, links, localization, readability and technical quality.

publish.body: Make the stack, public references and working method visible instead of relying on vague promises.

measure.body: Check whether the page attracts more relevant traffic and leads to more useful conversations.

proof.title: A clear method, a named stack and public references
proof.intro: Before we even speak, you can already see the tools being used, the kind of work being delivered and the public profiles connected to it.

web.title: Pages built to be clear, fast and conversion-oriented
web.body: Next.js, React, TypeScript, technical SEO and short iterations help produce sites and pages that build trust and make contact easier.

realtime.title: Demonstrations that make an idea concrete faster
realtime.body: Unreal, Unity and WebGL help show an interaction, test a scenario or let a stakeholder picture the result more quickly.

trust.title: Public profiles that extend the page’s credibility
trust.body: GitHub, ArtStation and LinkedIn are not decorative links. They connect the page to real, visible practice.

services.title: Services
services.webDesc: Websites and web apps built to convert: clear structure, technical SEO and strong performance.
services.realtimeDesc: Prototypes and immersive experiences built to make an idea concrete and speed up demonstrations.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Share your needs, constraints and timing. I’ll reply within 1 business day with a concrete recommendation and the next steps.
